entry.title: New: RES25-046 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR OR THE MAYOR'S DESIGNEE TO ENTER INTO A DEVELOPMENT CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU AND TC KIHAPAI LLC; ENTER INTO A GROUND LEASE BETWEEN THE CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU AND KIHAPAI PLACE APARTMENTS, LLLP; AND EXECUTE GRANTS OF UTILITY OR ACCESS EASEMENTS TO DEVELOP AN AFFORDABLE RENTAL HOUSING PROJECT AT 734 AND 735 KIHAPAI PLACE, KAILUA, OʻAHU, AND IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS (1) 4-3-058:065 AND 066.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
